title: The Second Lamp of Shornhelm
summary: Uncover a plot by coastal wreckers and a rogue vampire courtier to extinguish the cliff-beacons of Northpoint and plunge Rivenspire's three noble houses into blood-war.

npcs.name: Justiciar Corinne Dorell
npcs.greet: Look to the window-sills of Shornhelm, traveller—every household has lit the Second Lamp, for the dead and the night-drinkers are abroad in the crags.
talk: Three grain-barques bound for Northpoint were lured onto the reefs by false beacons, and House Tamrith is accusing House Dorell of starving their port.
Count Verandis's steward at Ravenwatch Castle believes the wreckers are commanded by a rogue blood-scion hiding in the crag-barrows.

npcs.name: Chamberlain Gaston
npcs.greet: Welcome to Ravenwatch Castle. Here we keep the compact that separates civilized blood-kin from the feral fiends of the crags.
talk: Viscountess Melisande, an exile of the Montclair line, has allied with the cliff-wreckers at Hoarfrost Downs to seize the Ayleid shards of Erokii Ruins.
Speak with Harbour-Master Ives in Northpoint; he barely escaped the last false-beacon wreck.

npcs.name: Harbour-Master Ives
npcs.greet: Forty good sailors went down on the black teeth below Northpoint because someone doused the whale-oil cresset and lit a lantern on the shoals!
talk: Wrecker-Captain Brulot and his cutthroats haul the salvaged cargo into Hildune's Secret Refuge while Viscountess Melisande delves into Erokii Ruins.
Put Brulot to the sword first so the Northpoint ships can sail again.

npcs.name: Warden Bastiaan
npcs.greet: Stand fast! Crimson mist has been seeping up from the Ayleid vaults of Erokii Ruins since dusk.
talk: Melisande is using the blood of shipwrecked sailors to awaken an Ayleid light-crystal inside Erokii Ruins.
Take the Shornhelm guard-sigil and strike her down in the vault!

story_rs_viscountess_melisande.name: Viscountess Melisande of the Crimson Crag

story_rs_northpoint_beacon: Harbour-Master Ives: Look at the beacon-brazier—drenched in alchemical brine so it wouldn't catch, while a false cresset burned on the reef below!
Chamberlain Gaston: And see the bat-wing wax seal on this smugglers' manifest? Viscountess Melisande's private cipher.
Harbour-Master Ives: She's caching the plunder in Hildune's Secret Refuge!
story_rs_hildune_den: Wrecker-Captain Brulot: Every hull that splits on Northpoint's rocks fills my casks with brandy and Melisande's chalices with warm throats!
Harbour-Master Ives: For the forty men of the Sea-Swallow—cut him down!
story_rs_erokii_crystal: Viscountess Melisande: While Dorell and Tamrith bicker over lantern-oil, the red crystal of Erokii will crown a house that never ages!
Warden Bastiaan: Shornhelm's Three Houses stand together tonight, blood-leech! Draw!

quests.title: The False Beacon of Northpoint
quests.summary: Consult Chamberlain Gaston at Ravenwatch Castle and inspect the sabotaged beacon in Northpoint with Harbour-Master Ives.
intro: Sabotaged lighthouses on the northern cliffs have wrecked three grain ships, threatening to ignite a civil war between Shornhelm's noble houses.
Speak with Chamberlain Gaston at Ravenwatch Castle, then travel to Northpoint to examine the beacon with Harbour-Master Ives.
complete: At Northpoint, you found Viscountess Melisande's cipher on a wrecker's manifest pointing toward Hildune's Secret Refuge.

journal.start: Justiciar Corinne in Shornhelm sent me to Ravenwatch Castle and Northpoint to investigate the lighthouse sabotage.
journal.done: We uncovered a compact between Wrecker-Captain Brulot and Viscountess Melisande.

objectives.text: Consult Chamberlain Gaston at Ravenwatch Castle
Inspect the sabotaged cresset in Northpoint
Speak with Harbour-Master Ives in Northpoint

quests.title: The Plunder of Hildune's Refuge
quests.summary: Storm Hildune's Secret Refuge and defeat Wrecker-Captain Brulot.
intro: Wrecker-Captain Brulot uses Hildune's Secret Refuge to store plundered grain and hand over surviving sailors to Melisande's thralls.
Enter Hildune's Secret Refuge and slay Captain Brulot.
complete: Wrecker-Captain Brulot fell, and his logbooks revealed that Melisande is awakening an Ayleid relic inside Erokii Ruins near Crestshade.

journal.start: I must enter Hildune's Secret Refuge and defeat Wrecker-Captain Brulot.
journal.done: I defeated Wrecker-Captain Brulot and learned Viscountess Melisande is inside Erokii Ruins.

quests.title: Riders of Shrouded Pass
quests.summary: Carry the wrecker logbooks through Shrouded Pass and rally Warden Bastiaan in Crestshade.
intro: To prevent House Tamrith and House Dorell from clashing at Shrouded Pass, carry the proof of Melisande's plot through the pass to Warden Bastiaan at Crestshade.
Cross Shrouded Pass and meet Warden Bastiaan in Crestshade.
complete: Warden Bastiaan halted the noble houses' feud and marshaled his guards outside Erokii Ruins.

journal.start: I must carry the wrecker logbooks through Shrouded Pass to Warden Bastiaan in Crestshade.
journal.done: Warden Bastiaan united the house guards for the assault on Erokii Ruins.

objectives.text: Carry the logbooks through Shrouded Pass

stages.objective: Carry the logbooks through Shrouded Pass

quests.title: The Red Crystal of Erokii
quests.summary: Enter Erokii Ruins, defeat Viscountess Melisande, and return to Justiciar Corinne in Shornhelm.
intro: Inside the Ayleid halls of Erokii Ruins, Viscountess Melisande is charging a blood-corrupted light-crystal to enthrall the crags.
Breach Erokii Ruins, slay Viscountess Melisande, and report your victory to Justiciar Corinne in Shornhelm.
complete: Viscountess Melisande has been destroyed, the Northpoint beacons burn clear once more, and Shornhelm's Three Houses have honored your service with the Shornhelm Blade.

journal.start: I must enter Erokii Ruins, defeat Viscountess Melisande, and report back to Justiciar Corinne in Shornhelm.
journal.done: I slew Viscountess Melisande in Erokii Ruins and received the Shornhelm Blade in Shornhelm.
